decision_conditions: <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The communal amenity space for the family sized unit on the first floor and the studio flat on the second floor would fail to provide private amenity space for the differing needs of the future occupiers of the proposed flats.&nbsp; Furthermore, any further division of the rear garden would result in a layout which would be out of character with the &nbsp;surrounding area contrary to &nbsp;the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 (7) and D6 of The London Plan (2021); policies DM1, DM26 and DM 27 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010)</span></span><br></p>

<div style="text-align: justify;"><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The proposed two storey side extension by reason of excessive width and failure to provide a subordinate roof is considered unsympathetic and does not complement the existing character of the original dwellinghouse and would appear as an incongruous feature in the streetscene and be harmful to the character and appearance of the existing property and&nbsp;area, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policy D3 (D(1) and (11)) of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 A, DM1 B (a), (b) and (c) of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span><br></p></div>

<ol start="2"><li style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="line-height:normal"><span arial="" style="">The proposed development, by reason of the shortfall in the minimum total gross internal area of flat 2,&nbsp;and lack of section drawings to demonstrate floor to ceiling heights would result in a cramped, substandard and inadequate quality of living accommodation for the future occupiers. The development would therefore fail to provide fit for purpose residential units of an appropriate design, quality and layout, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 (7) and D6 of The London Plan (2021), Policy&nbsp;CS1 K of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012); policies DM1 and&nbsp;DM 26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the Technical Housing Standards Nationally Described Space Standards (2015), the Mayor of London Plan Guidance Housing Design Standards (2023), the adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010) and Technical Housing Standards Nationally Described Space Standards (2015)</span><span arial="">.</span></span></li></ol><br data-cke-eol="1">

<ol start="3"><li style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify"><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The proposed balcony at second floor level by reason of its siting in close proximity to neighbouring properties would give rise to an unacceptable level of overlooking and loss of privacy contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 (7)&nbsp;of The London Plan (2021),; policy&nbsp;DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010)</span></span></li></ol><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>
description: Conversion of dwellinghouse to three flats (1 x 3 Bed; 1 x 2 Bed and 1 x Studio); two storey side extension; single and two storey rear extension; alterations and extension to roof to create habitable roof space; Juliette balcony to rear;  parking; bin / cycle storage; private and communal  amenity space; external alterations (demolition of detached garage; porch; rear extension and store)
